rule.description: SECEOKNIGHT ALERT: CREDENTIAL EXPOSURE DETECTED - $(email) - Passwords/Authentication credentials compromised in known breach
SECEOKNIGHT ALERT: CRITICAL SEVERITY BREACH - $(email) - Multiple sensitive data categories exposed (Financial/Personal/Email)
SECEOKNIGHT ALERT: HIGH SEVERITY BREACH - $(email) - Sensitive personal or email data exposed in public breach database
SECEOKNIGHT ALERT: MEDIUM SEVERITY BREACH - $(email) - Employee email found in moderate-risk breach incident
SECEOKNIGHT ALERT: LOW SEVERITY INCIDENT - $(email) - Email address detected in public data exposure (informational)
